abilities.name: Strength
abilities.description: Physical power. Governs melee damage, carrying capacity, and Strength-gated equipment. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.description: Senses and awareness. Governs ranged accuracy, detection, and initiative. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.description: Stamina and toughness. Governs hit points, the Stamina pool (action combat), fatigue, and resistance to poison and disease. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Intelligence
abilities.description: Reasoning and knowledge. Governs the skill-point gain rate, the mana pool, the power of all magic, and most knowledge skills. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Willpower
abilities.description: Mental resilience and force of will. Governs mana and stamina regeneration and magic resistance. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.description: Reflexes and finesse. Governs action economy and Action Points (turn-based), stealth, and dexterous skills. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Charisma
abilities.description: Force of personality. Governs persuasion, barter prices, and leadership. Scale 1-10.

abilities.name: Luck
abilities.description: Fortune. Adds a flat bonus to every check, raises critical-hit chance, and improves loot and random outcomes. Scale 1-10.
